title: hamiltonians-kam-tori widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the §5 KAM-tori illustration on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic. Three `<input type="range">` sliders ($\omega_1$, $\omega_2$, $\varepsilon$) all share a single .row above an SVG host showing a 2-torus orbit (closed curve when the frequency ratio is rational, dense winding when irrational, perturbed under a small KAM-style coupling). The all-sliders-in-one-row layout is bespoke; parametric-plot puts each slider in its own row.

sliders.description: Sliders rendered side-by-side inside a single .row.

sectionComment.description: ARTIFACT. Optional /* ... */ banner before the IIFE.

bodyScript.x-artifact: script body is bespoke; portable consumers should integrate the two-frequency torus winding from {sliders} alone
bodyScript.description: ARTIFACT. Verbatim JS statements that go inside `(function(){\n…\n})();` — wires the three sliders, draws the winding, applies the perturbation, and reports the frequency ratio.
